title: Kiora | Planeswalker
description: Read Kiora's biography; The tale of a merfolk planeswalker traveling the planes to strengthen her connection to the ocean's magic.

paragraphs.text: Cocky, brash, and occasionally selfish, Kiora is a merfolk Planeswalker who wields a magical bident she once stole from a god. She shares a close bond with creatures of the ocean, especially the titanic leviathans that lurk deep beneath the waves.
